title: Remove Size Bitrate Guards settings tab
summary: Remove the duplicate Size / Bitrate Guards tab and pane from the Settings WebView.
reason: The editable size, bitrate, and growth controls already live in Routing, so the separate linked orientation tab repeated the same information without adding an editing workflow.
behavior_before: Settings showed a separate Size / Bitrate Guards tab with read-only linked-to-Routing summary cards.
behavior_after: Settings no longer shows the Size / Bitrate Guards tab or duplicate read-only panel; Routing remains the settings surface for those controls.
rollback_plan: Restore the Size / Bitrate Guards tab button, its read-only pane, the related summary JS writes, and the previous WebView tab-order assertions.
notes: The routing controls and summary/effective-decision readout remain; only the duplicate Size / Bitrate Guards tab and pane were removed.
